biggest_catch: Weekly pay with no same-day option — you wait until Friday for the previous Monday–Sunday week, though On Demand Pay lets you pull part of your earnings early.
catches: Paid weekly: work Mon–Sun, paid the following Friday (direct deposit or check).
On Demand Pay gives early access to a portion of weekly earnings before payday, for a small fee (official: 'access your weekly earnings days before payday').
You are a W-2 employee (EmployBridge) — taxes withheld, which lowers take-home vs. quoted hourly rate.
Requires application, resume/profile, and an in-person interview; hiring is not instant.
Some jobs require drug screens; availability limited to Bluecrew metro areas.

steps: Download the Bluecrew app and apply (profile/resume).
Attend an in-person interview; pass background check (+ drug screen for some jobs).
Pick shifts from the app — each shows the hourly wage before you accept.
Work the shift as a W-2 employee (overtime and benefits eligible).
Get paid weekly (Friday for Mon-Sun week) via direct deposit, or tap On Demand Pay for early access to part of your earnings.
timing: Weekly: paid every Friday for the previous Monday–Sunday week (direct deposit or check). On Demand Pay allows early access to part of your weekly earnings before payday.

work_available: Hiring-based — you apply, submit a profile, and interview in person before getting matched to jobs. This is real temp hiring, not walk-in work.
what_gets_accepted: Complete your scheduled shifts as a W-2 employee. On Demand Pay lets you access part of your weekly earnings before payday for a small fee.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees. Unpaid time: the application, profile setup, and in-person interview before any work.
